Author: David Chang
My Review:
Disclaimer: I won a free ARC of this book in a Goodreads giveaway. I am also a huge fan of David Chang.

My expectations were very high with this book because I love David Chang's podcast and really enjoyed his first book. I was worried this would be a vanity cash-grabbing project that was superficial and vapid. I am happy to say this actually exceeded those expectations. Before the book really even begins, David readily admits his hesitance to write the book and acknowledges all the reasons he shouldn't do it.

He opens up about his life, his struggles and his journey. He talks about how difficult life is with some of this personal issues and it is really exceptional. I felt like I was on the journey with him from pompous, depressed chef to (semi) self-actualized businessman. His self-deprecating prose and astonishing memory of minute details makes this a real page turner.

Highly Recommend.
